The area of an isosceles right angled triangle is 16 m². Its hypotenuse is ________.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The area of an isosceles right-angled triangle is 16 m².

**Formula used:**

Area of an isosceles right-angled triangle = (1/2) × base × height

Since it is an isosceles right-angled triangle, base = height

Let base = height = x

So, Area = (1/2) × x × x = (1/2) × x²

**Calculation:**

(1/2) × x² = 16

⇒ x² = 32

⇒ x = √32

⇒ x = 4√2

Hypotenuse of an isosceles right-angled triangle = x√2

⇒ Hypotenuse = 4√2 × √2

⇒ Hypotenuse = 4 × 2

⇒ Hypotenuse = 8 m

**∴ The correct answer is option 4.**

questions.question: The speed of a boat in still water is 12 km/h, and the speed of the stream is 3 km/h. A man goes to a place by boat, 45 km and comes back to the starting point. Find the total time taken by him.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The speed of a boat in still water is 12 km/h, and the speed of the stream is 3 km/h. A man goes to a place by boat, 45 km and comes back to the starting point.

**Formula used:**

Speed downstream = (Speed of boat + Speed of stream)

Speed upstream = (Speed of boat - Speed of stream)

Time = Distance / Speed

**Calculation:**

Speed downstream = 12 + 3 = 15 km/h

Speed upstream = 12 - 3 = 9 km/h

Time taken to travel 45 km downstream:

⇒ Timedₒwₙₛₜᵣₑₐₘ = 45 / 15 = 3 hours

Time taken to travel 45 km upstream:

⇒ Timeᵤₚₛₜᵣₑₐₘ = 45 / 9 = 5 hours

Total time taken:

⇒ Total Time = Timedₒwₙₛₜᵣₑₐₘ + Timeᵤₚₛₜᵣₑₐₘ

⇒ Total Time = 3 + 5 = 8 hours

**∴ The correct answer is option 1.**

questions.question: From a circular sheet of circumference 264 cm, two equal maximum - sized circular plates are cut off. What will be the circumference of each plate? (Use π = (22)/(7))
questions.solution:
**Given:**

From a circular sheet of circumference 264 cm, two equal maximum-sized circular plates are cut off.

**Formula used:**

Circumference of a circle = 2πr

**Calculation:**

Total circumference of the sheet = 264 cm

Since two equal maximum-sized circular plates are cut off, the circumference of each plate will be half of the total circumference.

⇒ Circumference of each plate = 264 cm / 2

⇒ Circumference of each plate = 132 cm

**∴ The correct answer is option 1.**

questions.question: In an election a candidate secured 47% of the votes and lost to his only opponent by 276 votes. Find the total number of votes polled.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Candidate secured votes = 47%

Difference in votes = 276

**Formula used:**

Let total votes be V.

Votes secured by the winning candidate = 53% of V

Votes secured by the losing candidate = 47% of V

Difference = 53% of V - 47% of V

**Calculation:**

276 = 53% of V - 47% of V

⇒ 276 = (53/100)V - (47/100)V

⇒ 276 = (6/100)V

⇒ 276 = 0.06V

⇒ V = 276 / 0.06

⇒ V = 4600

**∴ The correct answer is option (2).**

questions.question: A solid metallic cylinder of base radius 6 cm and height 10 cm is melted to form small cylinders, each of height 2.5 cm and base radius 2 cm. Find the number of small cylinders.
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Number of small cylinders (n) = (R² × H) ÷ (r² × h)

Where **R, H** are dimensions of the **large cylinder** and **r, h** are for the **small cylinder**.

n = (6 × 6 × 10) ÷ (2 × 2 × 2.5)

n = 360 ÷ 10 = 36

**∴ The correct answer is 36.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Radius of large cylinder (R) = 6 cm

Height of large cylinder (H) = 10 cm

Radius of small cylinder (r) = 2 cm

Height of small cylinder (h) = 2.5 cm

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51bce5dd2cba86089df28d6f20e165e21d60913f224c14cc2d519c74a344e717.png] 

The **volume** of a cylinder is given by the formula: **V = πr²h**

⇒ Volume of the large cylinder = π × (6)² × 10

⇒ Volume of the large cylinder = π × 36 × 10 = 360π cm³

⇒ Volume of one small cylinder = π × (2)² × 2.5

⇒ Volume of one small cylinder = π × 4 × 2.5 = 10π cm³

⇒ Number of small cylinders (n) = (Volume of large cylinder) ÷ (Volume of small cylinder)

⇒ n = 360π ÷ 10π

⇒ n = 36

**∴ The correct answer is 36.**

**__Additional Information__**

Conservation of Volume

When a solid object is melted and recast into new shapes, the **total volume** remains the same, provided there is no wastage during the process.

Cylinder Surface Area Formulas

**Curved Surface Area (CSA)** = 2πrh | **Total Surface Area (TSA)** = 2πr(r + h).

Radius and Diameter

Always ensure the **radius** is used in the volume formula; if the diameter (d) is given, use r = d ÷ 2.</p

questions.question: R can finish a work in 6 days if he works 10 hours a day. S can finish it in 5 days if he works 8 hours a day. If both start a work and work daily for 6 hours, the work will be finished in _____ days.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

R can finish a work in 6 days if he works 10 hours a day.

S can finish it in 5 days if he works 8 hours a day.

Both start a work and work daily for 6 hours.

**Formula used:**

Work done per hour by R = Total work / (Number of days × Hours per day)

Work done per hour by S = Total work / (Number of days × Hours per day)

Total work done per hour by R and S = Work done per hour by R + Work done per hour by S

Total days to complete the work = Total work / (Total work done per hour by R and S × Hours per day)

**Calculations:**

Work done per hour by R = 1 / (6 × 10)

⇒ Work done per hour by R = 1 / 60

Work done per hour by S = 1 / (5 × 8)

⇒ Work done per hour by S = 1 / 40

Total work done per hour by R and S = (1 / 60) + (1 / 40)

⇒ Total work done per hour by R and S = (2 + 3) / 120

⇒ Total work done per hour by R and S = 5 / 120

⇒ Total work done per hour by R and S = 1 / 24

Total days to complete the work = 1 / (1 / 24 × 6)

⇒ Total days to complete the work = 24 / 6

⇒ Total days to complete the work = 4

**∴ The correct answer is option 3.**

questions.question: R and S can finish a work in 10 days, S and T can finish it in 12 days and T and R can finish in 8 days. In how many days will the work be finished if they all work simultaneously?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

R and S can finish a work in 10 days

S and T can finish a work in 12 days

T and R can finish a work in 8 days

**Formula used:**

Work done by R and S in 1 day = 1/10

Work done by S and T in 1 day = 1/12

Work done by T and R in 1 day = 1/8

Let work done by R, S, and T in 1 day be r, s, and t respectively

r + s = 1/10

s + t = 1/12

t + r = 1/8

**Calculation:**

Adding the three equations:

(r + s) + (s + t) + (t + r) = 1/10 + 1/12 + 1/8

⇒ 2r + 2s + 2t = 1/10 + 1/12 + 1/8

⇒ 2(r + s + t) = 1/10 + 1/12 + 1/8

⇒ r + s + t = 1/2 × (1/10 + 1/12 + 1/8)

Calculating the sum:

⇒ 1/10 + 1/12 + 1/8

⇒ 12/120 + 10/120 + 15/120

⇒ 37/120

So,

r + s + t = 1/2 × 37/120

⇒ r + s + t = 37/240

The work done by R, S, and T together in 1 day is 37/240

Therefore, the number of days required to finish the work is:

⇒ 240/37

**∴ The correct answer is option 3 (240/37).**

questions.question: At an election involving two candidates, 68 votes are declared invalid. The winning candidate gets 52% of the valid votes and wins by 98 votes. The total number of votes polled is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Winner's share = 52% of valid votes ⇒ Loser's share = 100% − 52% = 48%

Winning margin = 52% − 48% = 4% of valid votes

We know, 4% = 98 votes ⇒ 100% (Total Valid Votes) = 98 × 25 = 2450

Total votes polled = Valid votes + Invalid votes = 2450 + 68 = 2518

**∴ The correct answer is 2518.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Number of invalid votes = 68

Winning candidate gets 52% of the valid votes.

Winning margin = 98 votes.

 
 Total Votes = ?
 
 
• 
 
• 
 
 
 Valid Votes = 100%
 
 
 Invalid = 68
 
 
• 
 
• 
 
 
 Win: 52%
 
 
 Lose: 48%
 
 

 Margin: 4% = 98 votes

**Calculations:**

Let the total number of valid votes be x.

⇒ Loser's vote share = (100 − 52)% of x = 48% of x

⇒ Winning margin = Winner's share − Loser's share

⇒ Winning margin = 52% of x − 48% of x = 4% of x

According to the given condition:

⇒ 4% of x = 98

⇒ (4 ÷ 100) × x = 98

⇒ x = 98 × (100 ÷ 4)

⇒ x = 98 × 25

⇒ x = 2450

So, the total number of valid votes is 2450.

⇒ Total votes polled = Valid votes + Invalid votes

⇒ Total votes polled = 2450 + 68 = 2518

**∴ The correct answer is 2518.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Votes Polled

In election problems, Total Votes Polled = Valid Votes + Invalid Votes. Always calculate the valid votes using the given percentages first before adding the invalid numbers.

Winning Margin Percentage

The percentage by which a candidate wins is the difference between their vote percentage and the runner-up's vote percentage.

Base Percentage Value

To quickly find the base value (100%) when a certain percentage 'P' is known as value 'V', directly use the logic: Base = V × (100 ÷ P).

questions.question: The centres of two circles are 84 cm apart. If the radii of these two circles are 38 cm and 26 cm, respectively, then which of the following options gives the length (in cm) of a direct common tangent of these two circles?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Distance between the centers = 84 cm

Radius of first circle (r₁) = 38 cm

Radius of second circle (r₂) = 26 cm

**Formula used:**

Length of direct common tangent (L) = √(d² - (r₁ - r₂)²)

Where d = distance between the centers, r₁ and r₂ are the radii of the circles.

**Calculation:**

⇒ L = √(84² - (38 - 26)²)

⇒ L = √(7056 - 12²)

⇒ L = √(7056 - 144)

⇒ L = √6912

⇒ L = 48√3 cm

**∴ The length of the direct common tangent is approximately 48√3 cm.**

questions.question: Ramu mixes 2 litres of water at 100° C and 18 litres of water at 32° C. What temperature will the water have after mixing?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Water quantities and temperatures:

 
• Water 1: 2 litres at 100°C
 
• Water 2: 18 litres at 32°C

**Formula used:**

Final temperature (T) after mixing = (m₁ × T₁ + m₂ × T₂) / (m₁ + m₂)

Where m₁ and m₂ are the masses (or volumes in this case, since the density of water is uniform), and T₁ and T₂ are the temperatures of the water.

**Calculation:**

⇒ T = (2 × 100 + 18 × 32) / (2 + 18)

⇒ T = (200 + 576) / 20

⇒ T = 776 / 20

⇒ T = 38.8°C

**∴ The final temperature of the water after mixing is 38.8°C.**

questions.question: Ramesh's pocket money was reduced by 25%, and then the reduced pocket money was increased by 20%. Find the net increase or decrease percentage in his original pocket money.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Ramesh's pocket money is first reduced by 25% and then increased by 20%.

**Formula used:**

Final value = Initial value × (1 - Reduction%) × (1 + Increase%)

Net percentage change = ((Final value - Initial value) / Initial value) × 100

**Calculation:**

Let the original pocket money be ₹100.

After a 25% reduction:

⇒ ₹100 × (1 - 0.25) = ₹100 × 0.75 = ₹75

Now, increase the reduced amount by 20%:

⇒ ₹75 × (1 + 0.20) = ₹75 × 1.20 = ₹90

Now, calculate the net change:

⇒ Net percentage change = ((90 - 100) / 100) × 100

⇒ Net percentage change = (-10 / 100) × 100

⇒ Net percentage change = -10%

**∴ There is a net decrease of 10% in Ramesh's original pocket money.**

questions.question: 8 apples and 10 oranges weigh 5 kg. 12 apples and 20 oranges weigh 9 kg. What is the weight (in kg, rounded off to the nearest integer) of 15 apples and 24 oranges?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let **weight** of 1 apple be A and 1 orange be O.

From given: 8A + 10O = 5 and 12A + 20O = 9.

Double the first equation: 16A + 20O = 10. Subtract the second: 4A = 1 → A = 0.25 kg.

Substitute A: 8(0.25) + 10O = 5 → 2 + 10O = 5 → O = 0.3 kg.

Target: 15 × 0.25 + 24 × 0.3 = 3.75 + 7.2 = 10.95 kg.

Rounding 10.95 to the nearest **integer** gives 11.

**∴ The correct answer is 11 kg.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Weight of 8 **apples** and 10 **oranges** = 5 kg

Weight of 12 **apples** and 20 **oranges** = 9 kg

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/60951609245a1542071b18d56d23595decb85bbce357e95b560b28070e09aef6.png] 

Let the weight of one apple be x kg and one orange be y kg.

⇒ 8x + 10y = 5 --- (Eq. 1)

⇒ 12x + 20y = 9 --- (Eq. 2)

Multiplying (Eq. 1) by 2:

⇒ 16x + 20y = 10 --- (Eq. 3)

Subtracting (Eq. 2) from (Eq. 3):

⇒ (16x − 12x) + (20y − 20y) = 10 − 9

⇒ 4x = 1

⇒ x = 1/4 = 0.25 kg

Substituting x = 0.25 in (Eq. 1):

⇒ 8(0.25) + 10y = 5

⇒ 2 + 10y = 5

⇒ 10y = 3

⇒ y = 0.3 kg

Now, calculate the weight of 15 apples and 24 oranges:

⇒ Weight = 15x + 24y

⇒ Weight = 15(0.25) + 24(0.3)

⇒ Weight = 3.75 + 7.2

⇒ Weight = 10.95 kg

Rounding off to the nearest **integer**:

⇒ 10.95 ≈ 11 kg

**∴ The correct answer is 11 kg.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Simultaneous Linear Equations

These are a set of equations with multiple variables (like x and y) that are solved together to find a common solution using **Elimination** or **Substitution** methods.

Rounding Off Rules

When rounding to the nearest **integer**, look at the first decimal place. If it is 5 or greater (like .95), round up; if it is less than 5, round down.

Linear Combination Method

Sometimes unknown values can be found by adding or subtracting weighted versions of the given equations without solving for individual variables first.</p
